extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. description: NTRanch maker MCP: authoring, safety gates, playtest QA and release handoffs for adult games/apps. One NTRanch-lane maker surface for building NSFW games and apps end to end: it holds authored project state across sessions and enforces canon and safety decisions through a decide()-class gate before canonical writes. Credential tools manage references and status, never values. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Ardor does not expose an A2A endpoint.
